question: Reena runs at a speed of 8 km/h. How long will she take to cover 200 m?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **Speed** to m/s: 8 × 5/18 = 20/9 m/s.

**Time** = Distance ÷ Speed

**Time** = 200 ÷ (20/9) = 10 × 9 = 90 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 90 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Speed** (S) of Reena = 8 km/h

**Distance** (D) = 200 m

**Formula Used:**

1. **Speed Conversion:** 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

2. **Time** = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7234a918fd5e8af80fba47756fd1ab968c610170126e60d4ba94e38e44128332.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Speed** in m/s = 8 × (5/18) m/s

⇒ **Speed** = 40/18 = 20/9 m/s

⇒ **Time** = 200 ÷ (20/9)

⇒ **Time** = 200 × (9/20)

⇒ **Time** = 10 × 9 = 90 sec

Therefore, Reena will take 90 seconds to cover the distance, which corresponds to **Option 3**.

**∴ The correct answer is 90 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion for Speed

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Time, Speed, and Distance Relation

The fundamental relation is **Distance = Speed × Time**. Ensure all units are consistent (e.g., m and m/s, or km and km/h) before calculation.

Average Speed

Average Speed = (Total Distance Covered) ÷ (Total Time Taken). For two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).</p
